caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent drinking glass with a stem and a circular base, rendered with detailed shading in shades of gray. The bowl of the glass features an etched or engraved design that includes a bird, possibly a heron or crane, standing among leafy, flowering branches. The stalk is rounded and slightly bulbous at the midpoint, connecting to a broad, flat base. The drawing is centered on an off-white background with no additional objects or scenery, and the artist’s signature appears near the lower right corner of the image.
title: Celery Vase
